mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.status FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM role_permission rp INNER JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
AND rp.role_id IN
#{roleId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY p.permission_code ASC

SELECT DISTINCT rccs.category_id FROM role_course_category_scope rccs WHERE rccs.is_deleted = 0
AND rccs.role_id IN
#{roleId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY rccs.category_id ASC
